title: What goes with a new purchase
description: Before buying, an item is compared against real outfits from the wardrobe.

blocks.text: New clothes appeal on their own, but at home no suitable combination turns up.

quote.text: I use Alta so that i can see what i already have when I'm at a store and so I'll know what products match before buying them.

blocks.text: Add a temporary card and build a few outfits with the clothes already there. Once the decision is made, keep it in the closet or delete it.
Comparing images helps consider the combinations, but it does not confirm the size and the fit.
